description: This file defines the GitlabResourceOwner class, which implements ResourceOwnerInterface for handling GitLab user data within an OAuth2 client context. It includes methods for retrieving user info, creating an API client, and managing domain and token data.

classes.name: GitlabResourceOwner
classes.description: Represents a GitLab user resource owner, providing methods to access user details and create an authenticated API client.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource owner with response data and an access token.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Creates and returns an authenticated GitLab API client.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the domain associated with the resource owner.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the domain for the resource owner.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the user.

methods.name: getAvatarUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to the user's avatar.

methods.name: getProfileUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to the user's profile page.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the user is active.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin privileges.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Checks if the user is external.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all user data as an array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve data from the response array with an optional default.
